panels.missing: The man on the left is not the chaver. He has loose curly hair and wears a ragged ochre tunic with a red sash. He has no three ash stripes, no knot at the nape, no white cloth over his left shoulder and no sacred thread, so readers would take him for a different man from the priest in 4.5. Also no elbow is driven into Nagoji's ribs: the dagger arm's elbow only rests against his flank, and Nagoji stands upright instead of folding around a blow.
